Aaron Wiggins - Day-To-Day: Wiggins is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Heat due to a left knee contusion.
Mouhamed Gueye - Out: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
Henri Veesaar - Out: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

Coby White - Out: Head coach Charles Lee said Monday that White (calf) remains without a timeline for a return, though Lee added that he'll have a better idea of where things stand following the Hornets' two-game road trip, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.
Kon Knueppel - Out: Knueppel (hamstring) is without a timetable for a return, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.
Grant Williams - Out: Williams (hamstring) will be re-evaluated following Charlotte's upcoming two-game road trip, Rod Boone reports.
Kylan Boswell - Out: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.
Patrick Williams - Day-To-Day: Williams (groin) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Knicks.
Tobe Awaka - Day-To-Day: Awaka (ankle) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Knicks.
Nic Claxton - Out: Claxton (hamstring) participated in individual drills Monday morning and hopes to join the team for practice next week, Joe Cowley of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.
Santi Aldama - Out: The Mavericks recalled Aldama (knee) from the G League's Texas Legends on Tuesday.
Tarik Biberovic - Out: Biberovic is listed as doubtful for Wednesday's game against the Thunder.
Sergio de Larrea - Out: De Larrea (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Thunder.
Caleb Martin - Out: Martin (thumb) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Thunder.
Naji Marshall - Day-To-Day: Marshall (illness) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Thunder.
Kyrie Irving - Day-To-Day: Irving (knee) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Thunder.
Dereck Lively II - Out: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.
Spencer Jones - Out: Jones (hamstring) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against New Orleans.
Cameron Johnson - Day-To-Day: Johnson (ankle) is doubtful to face the Pelicans on Wednesday.
Alpha Diallo - Out: Diallo is out for Wednesday's game against the Pelicans due to personal reasons.
Julian Strawther - Out: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.
Isaiah Joe - Day-To-Day: Joe (hip) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Knicks.
Jalen Duren - Out: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Yaxel Lendeborg - Day-To-Day: Lendeborg (foot) is questionable for Wednesday's game against Minnesota.

Kristaps Porzingis - Out: Porzingis is contemplating his future in basketball as he deals with recurring symptoms from the autoimmune condition termed as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Moses Moody - Out: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Jimmy Butler III - Out: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Marcus Smart - Day-To-Day: Smart (forearm) is questionable for Wednesday's game versus the Bucks.
Alperen Sengun - Out: Sengun (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Bucks.
Steven Adams - Out: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could be out "a week or two" due to his right soleus strain, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.
Andrew Nembhard - Day-To-Day: Nembhard (neck) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against Philadelphia.
Tyrese Haliburton - Day-To-Day: Haliburton is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against the 76ers due to left hamstring tightness.
Obi Toppin - Day-To-Day: Toppin is probable to play Wednesday against the 76ers due to a left hand sprain.
Aaron Nesmith - Day-To-Day: Nesmith (hamstring) is probable for Wednesday's game against the 76ers.
T.J. McConnell - Out: McConnell (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game against the 76ers.
Ivica Zubac - Out: Zubac (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the 76ers.
Ben Sheppard - Out: Sheppard is scheduled for surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee Wednesday, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.
Johnny Furphy - Out: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.
Rui Hachimura - Out: Hachimura (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Lakers, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.
Bradley Beal - Out: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
Max Strus - Out: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
Yanic Konan Niederhauser - Out: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
Brandon Ingram - Out: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.
Jordan Miller - Out: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
Cameron Carr - Out: The Lakers recalled Carr (oblique) from the G League's Coachella Valley Lakers on Tuesday, Mark Medina of TheSportingTribune.com reports.
Adou Thiero - Out: Thiero (knee) is out for Tuesday's game against Portland.
Pelle Larsson - Day-To-Day: Larsson is listed as probable for Wednesday's game at Atlanta due to a right ankle sprain.
Simone Fontecchio - Day-To-Day: Fontecchio is doubtful for Wednesday's game in Atlanta due to an illness, per Tim Reynolds of Associated Press.
Anthony Edwards - Out: Edwards will undergo arthroscopic right knee surgery and is expected to miss up to two months, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Donte DiVincenzo - Out: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
Jordan Poole - Day-To-Day: Poole (illness) is listed as probable for Wednesday's game against Denver.
Yves Missi - Out: Missi has been diagnosed with a left knee bone bruise and he will miss an extended period of time, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

Jalen Williams - Out: Williams has been diagnosed with a dislocated left ankle and fractured fibula, which will require surgery, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Cason Wallace - Out: Wallace has been diagnosed with a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will require surgery, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Otega Oweh - Out: The Thunder plan to waive Oweh (Achilles) on Friday.
Jonathan Isaac - Out: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Wednesday's game against the Raptors.
Jalen Suggs - Out: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Paolo Banchero - Out: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Noah Penda - Out: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

Jabari Walker - Out: Walker (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Pacers.
Dominick Barlow - Out: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.
Ariel Hukporti - Out: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Tobias Harris - Out: Harris (calf) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Kings.
Jayden Quaintance - Out: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

Kawhi Leonard - Out: Leonard (knee) is expected to miss multiple weeks due to swelling in his left knee, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Jusuf Nurkic - Out: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.
